days.title: Cliffs and Coastal Landscapes
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: acantilado del Tajo
stops.detail: The Tajo cliff reaches 100 meters in height above the sea at its highest point, where the Tajo Tower, an ancient 16th-century watchtower, is located.

stops.name: Los Caños de Meca
stops.detail: The cliff is basically formed by calcarenite rock with horizontal layers of impermeable sandy marls, which causes the aquifers of the upper mountain to emerge at different points of the cliff wall, forming the famous 'spouts' that give the town of Los Caños de Meca its name.

days.title: Marshes and Historical Heritage
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: marismas del río Barbate
stops.detail: It protects the Breña pine forest, comprised between Los Caños de Meca and Barbate, next to the cliff and the maritime strip that border it, as well as the Barbate river marshes, which extend from La Barca de Vejer to the mouth of the river, bordering the hills of the Retín mountain range.

stops.name: Palomar de La Breña
stops.detail: Infrastructure is also being recovered, such as the La Breña Dovecote, the largest in Europe.
